status_statement: All six items verified. The aarch64 cross-build, the container image and the conda package now build and are smoke-tested for real; the reproducible build and SBOM were re-verified unchanged. Two items carry documented limitations rather than blockers: the conda package is built with rustc 1.98.1 (conda-forge's version) because rust-toolchain.toml is a rustup feature the recipe cannot use, and no linux/arm64 container image was built. Nothing was published.
revision_note: A previous revision recorded items 2, 3 and 4 as blocked/unbuilt. The environment was then provisioned and all three were re-run; resolved blockers are marked resolved rather than deleted.

items.detail: re-verified; identical hashes in both modes
real ARM aarch64 ELF built and run under qemu-aarch64; trimmed output identical to the host build
image built, smoke-tested, and reproducible across two builds
real conda-build produced an installable .conda; packaged binary executed. Built with rustc 1.98.1, not the pinned 1.91.0

toolchain.locked_flag_verified: adding an unlisted dependency makes cargo refuse: 'the lock file needs to be updated but --locked was passed'

mode_1_plain.caveat: embeds absolute source and registry paths from debug info; reproducible only at the same checkout path

mode_2_remapped.note: the portable mode; this is what a packager should use

aarch64_cross_build.resolved_by: provisioned aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc/-g++/-ld and an aarch64 sysroot at /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu

artifact.file_type: ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable, ARM aarch64, dynamically linked, interpreter /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1

smoke_test.cross_architecture_comparison: trimmed output FILE IS BYTE-IDENTICAL to the x86_64 build's
smoke_test.note: qemu is always invoked explicitly; binfmt_misc is never relied on

false_success_bugs_fixed.bug: binfmt_misc has qemu-aarch64 registered, so an aarch64 ELF 'runs' directly and a missing loader still yields shell exit status 0
false_success_bugs_fixed.fix: the smoke test always invokes qemu-aarch64 -L <sysroot> explicitly and checks the status

false_success_bugs_fixed.bug: the previous script could report BLOCKED and be read as success
false_success_bugs_fixed.fix: every failure path returns non-zero; exit 0 is reachable only at the end

explicit_exit_codes.1: build ok but smoke test failed

negative_controls.result: exit 3, 'cross toolchain incomplete; no build attempted'

negative_controls.what: replace qemu-aarch64 with a shim that always fails
negative_controls.result: exit 1 with '--version failed', 'failed to trim', 'output differs'

deployment_detail_found.problem: container runs as uid 10001, so a bind-mounted host directory must be writable by that uid
deployment_detail_found.observed_error: ERROR: cannot create output "/data/out.fq": Permission denied (os error 13)
deployment_detail_found.workaround_verified: wrote out.fq owned by the host user on a non-world-writable directory
deployment_detail_found.why_not_run_as_root: root inside the container would leave root-owned files on the host

recipe_bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: source `path: ..` resolved to packaging/ instead of the workspace root, so no Cargo.toml was found
recipe_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: path: ../.. (conda-build resolves path: relative to the recipe directory)

recipe_bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: `- cargo` was listed as a dependency, but no conda package named `cargo` exists, making the solve unsatisfiable
recipe_bugs_found_and_fixed.observed: Unsatisfiable dependencies for platform linux-64: {MatchSpec("cargo")}; cargo =* * does not exist
recipe_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: removed the separate cargo requirement; conda-forge's rust ships both rustc and cargo

recipe_bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: conda-build's default work directory lives inside the source tree, so copying the source fails
recipe_bugs_found_and_fixed.observed: AssertionError: Can't merge/copy source into subdirectory of itself
recipe_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: build with --croot outside the source tree

toolchain_mismatch.why_the_pin_cannot_be_honoured: rust-toolchain.toml is a rustup feature, and conda-forge's rust installs rustc/cargo directly under $BUILD_PREFIX/bin; there is no rustup and no 1.91.0 package
toolchain_mismatch.consequence: the conda binary (305c78e7...) is NOT the pinned 1.91.0 build (b722e9e0...); a different compiler produces different code
toolchain_mismatch.to_fix: require a conda rust at 1.91.0, or vendor a rustup toolchain in the sdist

conda_build_lint.note: the old `conda-build lint` subcommand was removed; `--check` is the nearest equivalent
conda_build_lint.check_is_unreliable: conda-build --check exited 0 even with an unsatisfiable dependency (cargo does not exist)

catches_what_check_tolerates: a dependency that is not a real package
stdlib_checker.negative_control: removing --locked from the build script -> FAIL

sbom.determinism: 5 runs -> 1 distinct hash; no timestamp; UUIDv5 serial derived from content

regression_status.qc_differential: 22/22 fixtures passed; MultiQC parses without warnings

remaining_limitations: the conda package is built with rustc 1.98.1, not the pinned 1.91.0, because conda-forge has no 1.91.0 and rust-toolchain.toml is a rustup feature the recipe cannot use
conda-build --check cannot be used as a gate: it returned 0 with an unsatisfiable dependency
the container image is amd64 only; no linux/arm64 image was built, so the aarch64 binary is verified but an aarch64 image is not
the SBOM is generated by a local stdlib script, not an ecosystem tool; it is deterministic and checksummed but not signed or attested
no signing or provenance attestation (cosign, SLSA) was attempted
nothing was published: no release, tag, dist upload, crates.io upload, conda channel upload or registry push

verification_attribution.note: Every command and every hash quoted was produced in this session. Container builds used passwordless sudo -n docker; conda-build ran from tests/ci/env/conda-build. Sub-instances in this session have no shell tool, so no independent run was possible.
